The Deconstructor Prime is automatically acquired upon obtaining Helios Prime. Note that this weapon also takes up one Companion inventory slot.

===Vaultings===
- On [https://www.warframe.com/news/chroma-prime-access-ends-december-18 December 7th, 2018], it was announced that Helios Prime, alongside Banshee Prime and Euphona Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on December 18th, 2018. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as-is.
